title: Clocked host configuration
statement: Let $SS$ and $AS$ be state types, let $s,a$ be nonnegative integers, and let $x$ be a finite Boolean input. Given an optional clock phase, an input-head position for $x$, state-machine tapes and head positions, attempt-machine tapes and head positions, a final tape and head position, and an output string, define the host configuration to have clock-phase state, those input and output data, and work tapes and head positions formed by concatenating the state-machine slots, the attempt-machine slots, and the final slot.
